name: Deliberate
note: Draws it rather than photographs it.
what: Built on the same Stable Diffusion 1.5 as the first machine here, then merged and sanded until it stopped looking like a photograph. Everything comes back as a painting: soft edges, warm light, a picture-book calm. It is just as wrong about hands, and the mistakes are easier to see because the rest is so tidy.
good: faces, weather, and anything you would rather see drawn

measured.note: Six pictures, one job, from the button to the folder landing, with four volunteers. In a four-way race from the same address it took 75.8s, Rev Animated 526.1s, and two models listed with volunteers were never picked up at all.
